senses.gloss: בית א׳ pr. n. pl. (Beth) Oni in Palestine, prob. identic with אוֹנוֹ.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:14">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 14</cite> <he>פגי בית א׳</he> (ed. Zuckerm. <he>בֵיתְיַאנֵי</he>, <he>בֵיתְיַינֵי</he>, Var. <he>ביתיני</he>) the unripe grapes of B. O. (Beth Yanai).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:6:3">Y. Git. IV, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ אסור וכ׳</he> if a slave fled to Oni, he must not be extradited (because O. is a Palestinean place). V. <cite ref="E00462"><he>הִינִי</he></cite> 3.
